# AxiePro

> Read-only, non-custodial analytics for Axie Infinity traders on the Ronin chain.
> Track sales, value Axies by traits and genes, and find undervalued deals.
> We never touch funds. Informational, not financial advice. Status: beta.

## Pages
- [Home](https://axiepro.io/): market pulse and overview.
- [Explorer](https://axiepro.io/explorer): look up any Axie by ID to see its traits and a valuation estimate. Full class/parts/gene filtering is coming soon.
- [Deals](https://axiepro.io/deals): Axie listings priced below their estimated value, ranked.
- [Analytics](https://axiepro.io/analytics): market trends, floor prices, and recent sales.
- [Meta](https://axiepro.io/meta): rising and falling trait trends.
- [Portfolio](https://axiepro.io/portfolio): your wallet holdings and profit/loss. Uses an optional, read-only Ronin wallet connection.
- [Breeding](https://axiepro.io/breeding): breed-vs-buy ROI. Coming soon.
- [Terms](https://axiepro.io/terms)
- [Privacy](https://axiepro.io/privacy)

## API
- Base URL: https://api.axiepro.io/api/v1
- OpenAPI docs: https://api.axiepro.io/api/v1/docs
- Read-only. Public market data is free.

## Data
- Sources: Ronin chain and Sky Mavis. Data may be delayed.
- Valuations are model estimates, not guarantees, and are not financial advice.
